title: Operator structural sweep: 99 cases over 15 scalar/value operators, before and after
upstream_status_verbatim: Fixed. `eval_op_unary_plus_surface` no longer routes through the coercing `eval_unary_numeric_surface`
status_plain: The operators were measured as a GROUP, never individually. Run operator-structural-sweep-001 put 99 cases across 15 scalar/value operators and scored 97 exact typed bit matches against live Excel, with both mismatches on OP_UNARY_PLUS (=+"2" published number:2 locally where Excel published text:2; =+TRUE published number:1 where Excel published logical:TRUE). After the fix, sweep-002 re-ran the SAME probe set and scored 99/99. That is 6.6 cases per operator on average and the source publishes no per-operator split, so no operator on this record may be given an individual figure. The remaining 8 of the 23 operators - the reference operators - were not covered by this run at all and have no figure of any kind. The build (16.0 build 20026, workbook Compatibility Version 2, exact typed equality) is stated in the stream's Ref notes, one section away from the 99/99 line; it is not restated on the scored line.
